# PropTech Atlas

> Open Product Knowledge Graph of real estate software — United States & France. 272 produits documentés, 154 disponibles aux États-Unis, 148 en France.

Les données sont statiques, versionnées et publiques. Aucun compte, aucune clé.
Chaque fiche décrit un produit ET son usage métier en immobilier, avec ses sources.

## API

- [Index et compteurs](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/api/index.json)
- [Catalogue complet](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/api/tools.json)
- [Une fiche](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/api/tools/{slug}.json)
- [Une catégorie](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/api/categories/{id}.json)
- [Taxonomie](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/api/taxonomy.json)
- [Graphe de connaissance](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/api/graph.json)

## Catégories

- [CRM & lead management](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/crm-lead) — Capture, qualify and nurture buyer, seller and tenant leads. (18)
- [Transaction & closing management](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/transaction-management) — Run a deal from offer to closing — forms, e-signature, compliance, commissions. (7)
- [Portals & marketplaces](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/portals-marketplaces) — Where supply meets demand in public — consumer portals, listing networks and transactional marketplaces. (12)
- [Market data & property intelligence](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/market-data) — Comparables, ownership, transactions, rents, footfall and the datasets other products are built on. (17)
- [Listing publishing & syndication](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/listing-syndication) — Software that formats and pushes a portfolio of listings out to portals and partner networks. (5)
- [Agent websites & marketing](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/agent-marketing) — Websites, IDX search, branding and campaigns for agents and brokerages. (9)
- [Valuation, pricing & farming](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/estimation-pricing) — Automated valuation, comparables, owner farming and pricing intelligence. (7)
- [Residential property management](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/property-management) — Leases, rent, owners, tenants, maintenance and trust accounting. (28)
- [HOA & condominium management](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/syndic-copro) — Manage co-owned buildings — budgets, assemblies, calls for funds, works. (19)
- [Commercial asset & property management](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/commercial-am) — Institutional-grade lease, asset and portfolio administration. (8)
- [Investment analysis & underwriting](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/investment-underwriting) — Model a deal, run scenarios, produce an investment memo. (5)
- [Lending, mortgage & brokerage](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/lending-mortgage) — Originate, price and service real estate debt. (11)
- [Title, escrow & legal](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/title-closing-legal) — Title search, escrow, deeds and the legal chain of a transfer. (9)
- [Construction & development](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/construction-development) — Feasibility, project management, site supervision and delivery. (15)
- [Facility management & maintenance](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/facility-maintenance) — Work orders, contractors, assets and preventive maintenance. (14)
- [Energy, ESG & building performance](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/energy-esg) — Meter data, carbon trajectory, regulatory reporting and retrofit planning. (7)
- [Tenant experience & smart building](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/tenant-experience) — Occupant apps, access, bookings, services and building IoT. (12)
- [Flex space & coworking](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/flex-coworking) — Memberships, desk booking, billing and community for flexible workspace. (13)
- [Short-term rental management](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/short-term-rental) — Channel management, pricing, guest comms and cleaning for STR portfolios. (10)
- [Visuals, 3D tours & staging](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/visuals-tours) — Photography, floor plans, virtual tours and virtual staging. (9)
- [Diagnostics & compliance](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/diagnostics-compliance) — Mandatory surveys, disclosures and regulatory files attached to a property. (11)
- [Tenant screening & rent guarantee](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/tenant-screening) — Verify an applicant's file, guarantee the rent, sign the lease. (11)
- [Real estate back office & accounting](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/back-office-accounting) — Trust accounting, owner statements, commissions and brokerage back office. (7)
- [AI agents & automation](https://flowmetrik.github.io/proptech-atlas/categories/ai-assistants) — LLM-native assistants that answer, qualify, draft and act on real estate work. (8)

## Deux niveaux de fiabilité, à ne pas confondre

**La prose est rédigée, non recoupée.** `description`, `real_estate_use`, `features` et
`use_cases` sont écrits à partir du contenu public de l'éditeur. Chaque fiche porte
`verification.status` ; tant qu'il vaut `unverified`, ne pas présenter son contenu comme un
fait établi. Actuellement vérifiées : 0 / 272.

**Les signaux sont machine-vérifiés.** Le bloc `signals` de chaque fiche a été établi en
allant lire le site de l'éditeur à la date `checked_on`, et chaque signal porte l'URL qui
l'établit. Un signal absent signifie « pas trouvé à cette date », jamais « n'existe pas ».
Relevés : 258 outils · tarifs publics 65 · doc d'API 18 · page sécurité 31 · page confidentialité 190 · page d'état 63.

**Les avis ne sont jamais inventés.** 0 agrégat(s) externe(s) daté(s) au
catalogue. Une note sans URL de source et sans date de relevé est refusée par le validateur.

**Les logos** viennent du site de l'éditeur (254 / 272), avec leur
URL d'origine et la date du relevé. Marques et logos appartiennent à leurs détenteurs.
